mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO third_match_team_relation(id, match_id, team_id, match_position, team_name_record, remark, create_time, modify_time) VALUES
(#{item.id}, #{item.matchId}, #{item.teamId}, #{item.matchPosition}, #{item.teamNameRecord}, #{item.remark}, REPLACE(unix_timestamp(current_timestamp(3)),'.',''), REPLACE(unix_timestamp(current_timestamp(3)),'.',''))

update.foreach:
UPDATE third_match_team_relation
team_id = #{item.teamId},
match_position = #{item.matchPosition},
team_name_record = #{item.teamNameRecord},
remark = #{item.remark},
modify_time = REPLACE(unix_timestamp(current_timestamp(3)),'.','')
WHERE id = #{item.id}

mapper.select: SELECT sp.third_source_player_id thirdSourcePlayerId, tm.team_id teamId, tm.match_id matchId, tm.match_position matchPosition FROM third_match_team_relation tm LEFT JOIN third_team_player_relation tp ON tm.team_id = tp.team_id LEFT JOIN third_sport_player sp ON sp.id = tp.player_id WHERE tm.match_id = #{matchId} ORDER BY sp.third_source_player_id,tp.modify_time DESC
